noPermission.title: Counting is not open to you here
noPermission.body: Counting by scan needs the permission to count stock. Ask your team leader.

offline.line: No network: a unit you scan is kept on this tablet and sent when the network is back.
offline.bin: No network: every unit is kept on this tablet and sent when the network is back. Bin done waits for the network.

what.title: What to count

scan.label: Scan a bin to count it
scan.hint: The label on the shelf or the bin

empty.title: No count planned
empty.body: No count planned. Scan a bin to count it.

what.error: What to count could not be read. Scan a bin to count it anyway.
what.notOnTablet: What to count is not on this tablet. Scan a bin you counted here to go on.

row.yoursWhy: You counted this bin: a recount is done by another person.

choose.title: Which count is {place} counted for?
choose.hint_one: {count} count counts this bin: tap the one you count for.
choose.hint_other: {count} counts count this bin: tap the one you count for.

bin.frozen: Wait until each line is counted
bin.blind: Blind count: what it should hold shows after Bin done
bin.counted: Every line of this bin is counted: the office asks a recount to count it again.

scan.label: Scan every unit
scan.hint: A hide's, roll's or remnant's tag counts by itself; a lot's label asks how much

pad.label: How much
pad.blind: Count what you see: the number it should be shows after Bin done.

lines.title: In this bin
lines.empty: Nothing was here at the start of the count: scan what you find.
lines.keptOnly: This tablet has not read this bin's lines: every unit you scan is matched by the office.
lines.keptUnknown_one: {count} unit kept on this tablet is matched by the office when it is sent.
lines.keptUnknown_other: {count} units kept on this tablet are matched by the office when they are sent.

last.added: {code}: {quantity} counted, found here and not expected
last.already: Already counted: {code} is in this count once. Scan the next unit.

done.title: Differences
done.noneBody: Everything that should be here was scanned, and nothing more.
done.moved_one: {count} move into or out of this bin since the count started: check it before you finish.
done.moved_other: {count} moves into or out of this bin since the count started: check them before you finish.
done.lookAgainHint: Look again: scan what you find, then Bin done again. Finish bin sends the bin as it is for approval.

finished.title: Bin {place} finished
finished.body: {counted} of {lines} lines of count {number} are counted.
finished.keptBody: Kept on this tablet: count {number} gets it when the network is back.
finished.recounts_one: Another person recounts line {lines}: the difference is over the recount rule.
finished.recounts_other: Another person recounts lines {lines}: the differences are over the recount rule.
finished.approval: The office checks the count's differences and approves them before any stock changes.

held.binDoneOffline: Bin done needs the network: what the bin should hold is with the office.
held.keptWaiting_one: {count} unit still waits on this tablet: Bin done once it is sent.
held.keptWaiting_other: {count} units still wait on this tablet: Bin done once they are sent.

NOT_COUNTING.message: This count is not being counted now
NOT_COUNTING.fix: Its bins are counted while the count runs. Ask the office.

OUTSIDE_COUNT.message: {code} is not part of this count
OUTSIDE_COUNT.fix: Count only what this count counts. Put it aside and tell the office.

UNKNOWN_LABEL.message: Nothing at this site carries the label {code}
UNKNOWN_LABEL.fix: Scan a hide's, roll's or remnant's tag or a lot's label. A material without a label: tap its line and type how much.

NAME_THE_HIDE.message: This material is counted hide by hide

NOT_IN_BIN.message: That line is not one of this bin
NOT_IN_BIN.fix: Scan the bin the line belongs to.

SCAN_THE_HIDE.message: A hide is counted by its tag

LINE_COUNTED.fix: The office asks a recount to count it again.

ALREADY_COUNTED.fix: Each tag counts once. Scan the next unit.

OWN_RECOUNT.message: You counted this line: another person recounts it
OWN_RECOUNT.fix: Ask a colleague to recount this bin.

QUANTITY.fix: Type how much on the pad.

NOTHING_TO_FINISH.message: Every line of this bin is counted already

NOT_A_PLACE.message: No place of this site carries the label {code}
NOT_A_PLACE.fix: Scan the label of a bin here.

NO_COUNT_HERE.fix: Scan a bin from What to count, or ask the office to start a count.

BADGE.fix: Scan your own badge, or ask your team leader.
